text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 242, June 29, 1970 ]
CREATING A COOPERATIVES COORDINATING COMMITTEE
WHEREAS, the cooperative movement plays an important role in the stabilization of prices of public
commodities; and
WHEREAS, there is need for the different sectors thereof to cooperate with and assist each other, coordinate
their activities and establish direct business relationships among themselves so that the movement may most
effectively serve producers not only in helping solve the nation’s economic problems but also those of
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by law, do hereby create a Cooperatives Coordinating Committee composed of the following:

Wholesale Society
